content: {"episode_id":"ep-05057","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, for this episode. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1), occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10). Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting, as stated in the ordering note. Because the payer letter states this decision does not preclude a corrected claim or appeal, we request reconsideration of the authorization requirement and payment of the outstanding balance of 702.81."}
